## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# Input data
year <- c(2016, 2024)
absentee_ballots <- c(111844, 77738) 

# Create a dataframe
election_data <- data.frame(year, absentee_ballots)

# Create a bar plot comparing absentee ballots in 2016 and 2024
ggplot(election_data, aes(x = factor(year), y = absentee_ballots, fill = factor(year))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Absentee Voter Ballots Cast in the 2016 and 2024 General Elections",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Absentee Ballots Cast") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2016" = "orange", "2024" = "purple")) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Input data for registered voters
year <- c(2016, 2020, 2024)
registered_voters <- c(580354, 600401, 603980) 

# Create a dataframe
election_data <- data.frame(year, registered_voters)

# Create a bar plot comparing registered voters in 2016, 2020, and 2024
ggplot(election_data, aes(x = factor(year), y = registered_voters, fill = factor(year))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Registered Voters in Hamilton County (10/25/2024)",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Registered Voters") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2016" = "orange", "2020" = "green", "2024" = "purple")) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Input data for absentee ballots and registered voters
election_year <- c(2016, 2024)
absentee_voters <- c(111844, 77738)  
registered_voters <- c(580354, 603980)  

# Calculate the percentage of absentee voters
absentee_percentage <- (absentee_voters / registered_voters) * 100

# Create a data frame
election_data <- data.frame(election_year, absentee_percentage)

# Create a bar plot comparing absentee voter percentages in 2016 and 2024
ggplot(election_data, aes(x = factor(election_year), y = absentee_percentage, fill = factor(election_year))) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Percentage of Absentee Voters Compared to Registered Voters (10/25/2024)",
       x = "Election Year",
       y = "Absentee Voter Percentage (%)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("2016" = "orange", "2024" = "purple")) +
  theme_minimal()

```
